newsitem.title: USA: Hughes wins $10 mln contract from China.
newsitem.headline: Hughes wins $10 mln contract from China.

text.p: An operating unit of Hughes Technical Services Co has won a $10 million contract to develop a satellite ground processing system in China, the company said Wednesday.
Hughes STX Corp will develop the system for the China Center for Resources Satellite Data and Applications, it said.
The system will process data for a satellite jointly developed by China and Brazil to provide remote sensing data for environmental monitoring, it said.
Hughes STX is based in Lanham, Md.
Hughes Technical Services Co is a subsidiary of Hughes Aircraft Co, which in turn is a unit of Hughes Electronics Corp.
